name: Greenwood Beach Resort
brand_truth: Pauline and Antoine's small beachfront resort at the south end of Cat Island, where the diving and kitesurfing start at the beach.

design.signature: Interactive journey map FXE/Nassau to New Bight to Port Howe

current_site_findings: Both rooms share the same one-line description.
View room, Explore rooms, Discover activities, Lunch and Dinner buttons all lead back to the same page.
No phone number or email on the homepage.
Port Howe and the south of Cat Island are never named, so Google cannot place you.
The excellent flight, taxi and car guide is hidden on a separate page.
pitch_line: Your travel guide is the best thing on your site and nobody sees it; this concept puts the journey, the rooms and the booking button in front of every guest in the first two screens.
assumptions: Private bathroom in both rooms (from a 2019 dive-operator page)
Room audiences: King for couples and solo travellers, Family for families and small groups
Lunch and dinner menus available on request
notes: Prospect record said no site, but greenwoodbeachresort.com is live (rebuilt 2026); treated as Track A redesign. Photos hotlinked from their own site, crops not visible in sandbox: check online. Resort is reportedly listed for sale (HG Christie), so the owner may value a stronger site for the sale too. Phone numbers: two published; WhatsApp not confirmed, so enquiries go by email. Reference sites not scraped to save budget.
